name: check_sender_blocked
description: Check if a sender email address is blocked

name: check_sender_trusted
description: Check if a sender email address is trusted (whitelisted)

name: create_contact

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

additionalInfo.description: Additional notes about the contact (can be HTML)

isHtml.description: Whether additional info is HTML formatted

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

groupName.description: The name of the contact group

memberEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to include in the group

name: create_content_filter
description:
Create a content filter (inbox rule).

Conditions JSON format: [{"fieldType": 0, "filterType": 2, "searchArguments": ["value"]}]
- fieldType: 0=FromAddress, 1=FromDomain, 3=WordsInSubject, 4=WordsInBody, 10=ToAddress, 16=HasAttachments, 17=AttachmentFilename
- filterType: 0=Equals, 1=DoesntEqual, 2=Contains, 3=DoesntContain

Actions JSON format: [{"actionType": 4, "argument": "FolderName"}]
- actionType: 1=Delete, 4=MoveToFolder (arg=folder), 5=AddHeader (arg=Header:Value), 6=PrefixSubject (arg=prefix), 7=Forward (arg=email), 8=MarkAsRead

Example: Create filter to move newsletters to a folder:
  title: "Newsletter Filter"
  matchType: "And"
  conditions: [{"fieldType": 0, "filterType": 2, "searchArguments": ["newsletter@"]}]
  actions: [{"actionType": 4, "argument": "Newsletters"}]

matchType.description: Match type: 'And' (all conditions must match) or 'Or' (any condition matches)

name: create_content_filter_simple
description:
Create a content filter (inbox rule) using simple human-readable descriptions instead of JSON.

Condition examples (separate multiple with semicolons):
  'from contains newsletter@' - match sender address containing text
  'from equals user@example.com' - match exact sender address
  'from domain is example.com' - match sender domain
  'subject contains invoice' - match subject line
  'body contains unsubscribe' - match email body
  'to contains sales@' - match recipient
  'has attachments' - match emails with attachments
  'attachment name contains .pdf' - match attachment filename
  'attachment extension is pdf' - match attachment extension

Action examples (separate multiple with semicolons):
  'move to Newsletters' - move to folder
  'delete' - delete the email
  'mark as read' - mark as read
  'forward to bob@example.com' - forward to address
  'prefix subject with [NEWS]' - add prefix to subject
  'set priority high' - set priority (high/normal/low)
  'flag' - flag for follow up

Supports negation: 'from does not contain X', 'subject doesn't contain X'

when.description: Condition(s) in plain English. Separate multiple conditions with semicolons.

then.description: Action(s) in plain English. Separate multiple actions with semicolons.

matchAll.description: Whether all conditions must match (true) or any condition can match (false). Default: true

replyToUid.description: Optional: UID of email being replied to

replyToFolder.description: Optional: Folder of email being replied to

isReply.description: Set to true if this is a reply

isForward.description: Set to true if this is a forward

type.description: The type of the new folder: 1=email, 2=calendar, 3=contact, 4=note, 5=task

parentFolderId.description: The ID of the parent folder (for mail folders)

description: Create a new note in the specified folder

folderId.description: The ID of the note source

content.description: The html or plain text content of the note

color.description: The color to associate with the note (white, yellow, pink, green, blue)

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

name: delete_contacts

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

contactIds.description: The IDs of the contacts to delete

name: delete_content_filters

name: delete_note
description: Delete a note in the specified folder

noteId.description: The ID of the note to delete

folderId.description: The ID of the note source

name: delete_task
description: Delete a task from the specified folder

folderId.description: The ID of the task source

taskId.description: The ID of the task to delete

name: domain_add_content_filter
description: Add a content filter that applies to every user in your domain. conditions: JSON array of {fieldType, filterType, searchArguments, applyLogicalNot?, isWildcard?}; fieldType is a name such as FromAddress, FromDomain, WordsInSubject, WordsInBody, WordsInSubjectOrBody, WordsInFrom, WordsInTo, WordsInHeaders, ToAddress, ToDomain, CcAddress, AttHas, AttFilename, AttExtension, MessageSizeOver, MessageSizeUnder, SendingServerIP, SpamWeight, IsAuthenticated, AutomatedMessage; filterType is Equals, DoesntEqual, Contains or DoesntContain; searchArguments is a list of strings. actions: JSON array of {actionType, argument?}; actionType is one of NoAction, Delete, Bounce, MoveToFolder (argument = folder name), AddHeader (argument = header line), PrefixSubject (argument = prefix text), Forward (argument = address), Read, SetPriority, FollowUp. Example: conditions=[{"fieldType":"FromDomain","filterType":"Equals","searchArguments":["spammy.example"]}], actions=[{"actionType":"Delete"}].

conditions.description: JSON array of conditions (see tool description)

actions.description: JSON array of actions (see tool description)

matchType.description: 'And' (all conditions must match, default) or 'Or' (any condition)

enabled.description: Whether the filter is active (default true)

name: domain_add_domain_alias
description: Add a domain alias: mail to <anything>@aliasName will be delivered to the matching mailbox in your domain. Optionally require the alias's MX records to point here first.

checkMx.description: Refuse unless the alias's MX records point at this server (default false)

name: domain_add_mailing_list_posters
description: Add email addresses to a mailing list's approved posters (allowed to post) or to its banned users (may neither post nor subscribe). Requires a domain admin account.

listType.description: Which list: 'approved' (default) for approved posters, or 'banned' for banned users

name: domain_add_mailing_list_subscribers
description: Subscribe one or more email addresses to a mailing list, as regular subscribers or as digest subscribers. If the list uses double opt-in, SmarterMail may email each address a confirmation first. Requires a domain admin account.

digest.description: True to add them as digest subscribers instead of regular subscribers (default false)

name: domain_check_address_available
description: Check whether an address (local part, e.g. 'sales') is free to use for a new user or alias in your domain. success:true means it is available.

address.description: Local part to check, e.g. 'sales' (a full address is trimmed to its local part)

name: domain_clear_subscriber_bounces
description: Reset a subscriber's bounce count to zero, e.g. after their mailbox problem was fixed, so the list stops treating them as bouncing. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_create_alias
description: Create an email alias in your domain that delivers mail to one or more target addresses.

targets.description: Email addresses that receive mail sent to the alias

internalOnly.description: True to only accept mail from inside the domain (default false)

allowSending.description: True to let target users send mail as this alias (default false)

hideFromGAL.description: True to hide the alias from the Global Address List (default false)

name: domain_create_dkim_rollover
description: Start a DKIM key rotation: generates a new key pair that stays pending (the current key keeps signing) until its DNS record is published and verified with domain_verify_dkim(rollover=true). Returns the new selector and public key to publish.

name: domain_create_mailing_list
description: Create a new mailing list in your domain. Anything not given here uses SmarterMail's defaults; change more with domain_update_mailing_list. Requires a domain admin account.

listAddress.description: List address, local part only (e.g. 'announce' becomes announce@<your domain>)

moderatorAddress.description: Email address of the list moderator

doubleOptIn.description: True to require subscribers to confirm by email (double opt-in) (optional)

subjectPrefix.description: Text to prefix every list message's subject with, e.g. '[announce]' (optional; turns on the prefix)

showInGal.description: True to show the list in the Global Address List (optional)

name: domain_create_shared_resource
description: Create a domain-level shared resource: a shared calendar, conference room, piece of equipment, address book, task list or note list. Rooms and equipment can be booked by inviting their email alias.

emailAlias.description: Email alias (local part) for booking rooms/equipment (optional)

userAccess.description: Access level for those users: 'availability', 'read', 'manage' or 'owner' (default 'read')

bookingWindow.description: How far ahead rooms/equipment can be booked: 'three_months', 'six_months', 'one_year', 'two_years' or 'no_limit' (default 'no_limit')

name: domain_create_signature
description: Create a domain signature template. The text may be HTML and may contain SmarterMail signature variables. Assign it with domain_set_signature_mapping.

isDefault.description: Make this the domain's default signature (default false)

name: domain_create_user
description: Create a new user in your domain. Domain default settings apply to anything not given here.

username.description: Username (local part only, e.g. 'jane'); the address becomes jane@<your domain>

password.description: Initial password; must meet the domain's password requirements

maxMailboxSizeMb.description: Maximum mailbox size in MB (optional; 0 means no limit; omit to use the domain default)

isDomainAdmin.description: True to make the new user a domain administrator (default false)

name: domain_create_user_group
description: Create a user group in your domain. Groups are used to assign permissions, signatures and shared resources to several users at once.

members.description: Initial members: usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain (optional)

enabled.description: Whether the group is active (default true)

name: domain_delete_alias
description: Permanently delete an alias from your domain. Mail sent to it will no longer be delivered.

name: domain_delete_content_filters
description: Permanently delete domain-level content filters by id. They stop applying to every user in your domain.

name: domain_delete_dkim_rollover
description: Cancel a pending DKIM key rotation: deletes the pending rollover key without activating it. The active key is unaffected.

name: domain_delete_domain_aliases
description: Delete one or more domain aliases. Mail to those domain names will no longer be delivered to this domain.

aliasNames.description: Domain alias names to delete, e.g. ['example.net']

name: domain_delete_event_hooks
description: Delete one or more event hooks. They stop firing immediately.

name: domain_delete_mailing_lists
description: Permanently delete one or more mailing lists, with all their subscribers, posters and settings. This cannot be undone. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_delete_shared_resource
description: Permanently delete a domain shared resource and everything in it (events, contacts, tasks or notes). Cannot be undone.

folderId.description: folderId from domain_list_shared_resources

name: domain_delete_signature
description: Permanently delete a domain signature template. Anyone mapped to it stops getting it on outgoing mail.

name: domain_delete_subscriber_fields
description: Delete one or more custom subscriber fields, and every subscriber's value for them. This cannot be undone. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_delete_user_groups
description: Delete one or more user groups in your domain. The member users are not deleted, but lose whatever the group granted them.

name: domain_delete_users
description: Permanently delete one or more users in your domain and all of their mail data. Cannot delete the primary domain admin or yourself. This cannot be undone.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts, e.g. 'jane') or full email addresses in your domain

name: domain_disable_dkim
description: Turn off DKIM signing for your domain. Any pending DKIM key is deleted. Outgoing mail stops being signed immediately, which can hurt deliverability where receivers expect DKIM.

name: domain_disable_two_factor
description: Turn off two-step authentication for one user in your domain, e.g. when they lost their authenticator device. They can sign in with just their password until they set it up again.

username.description: Username (local part) or email address in your domain

name: domain_disable_users
description: Disable (or re-enable) one or more users in your domain. A disabled user cannot sign in.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts, e.g. 'jane') or full email addresses in your domain

disable.description: True to disable the users (default), false to enable them again

allowMail.description: When disabling: true to keep delivering incoming mail to the disabled mailboxes (default false)

name: domain_disconnect_users
description: Force users in your domain to sign in again: ends their webmail sessions and/or drops their open protocol connections (IMAP, POP, ActiveSync, …). Useful after a password change or a suspected compromise.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

protocolConnections.description: Drop protocol connections such as IMAP, POP and ActiveSync (default true)

name: domain_enable_dkim
description: Turn on DKIM signing for your domain. If no DKIM key exists yet, a pending key is created; publish its selector and public key in DNS (see domain_get_dkim), then run domain_verify_dkim. Without forceActivation an active key that fails DNS validation is moved back to pending.

forceActivation.description: Force the key active even if DNS validation fails (default false; not recommended — receivers will fail DKIM checks until DNS is right)

name: domain_expire_user_passwords
description: Mark the passwords of one or more users in your domain as expired, so they must choose a new one at their next sign-in.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

name: domain_get_account_counts
description: Get a quick overview of your domain's size: number of users, aliases, administrators, groups, ActiveSync and MAPI/EWS mailboxes and mailing lists, with the domain's limits.

name: domain_get_alias
description: Get the full configuration of one alias in your domain: targets, display name, GAL visibility, internal-only, sending permission and more.

name.description: Alias name (local part, e.g. 'sales') or full alias address

name: domain_get_dkim
description: Get your domain's DKIM signing configuration: whether signing is active, the selector and public key to publish in DNS, key size, canonicalization, signed header fields, and any pending rollover key with its DNS status. Private keys are never returned.

name: domain_get_event_catalog
description: Get the event types an event hook can fire on (with their conditions, arguments and available actions) and, optionally, the variables usable in action text. Read this before creating an event hook. Large response.

includeVariables.description: Also include the event variables (default true)

name: domain_get_forward_blacklist
description: Get the forwarding blacklist: addresses and domains that users in your domain may not auto-forward mail to.

name: domain_get_info
description: Get basic information about your domain: name, hostname, enabled state, user/alias/list counts and limits, and disk usage.

name: domain_get_last_login_times
description: Get the last login time of every user in your domain, with enabled and domain-admin flags. Useful for finding inactive accounts.

referenceDate.description: Reference date in yyyy-MM-dd format that the server evaluates login times against (default: today)

name: domain_get_mailbox_forwarding
description: Get where one user's incoming mail is forwarded: the forward-to addresses, whether a copy is kept, whether original recipients are kept, and how spam is handled.

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address in your domain

name: domain_get_mailing_list
description: Get the full settings of one mailing list (posting permissions, digest, double opt-in, subject prefix, throttling, custom To/From/Reply-To, unsubscribe text, spam filtering, GAL visibility…) together with its counts of subscribers, digest subscribers, posters, banned users, custom fields and system messages. The posting password, if any, is redacted. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_get_mailing_list_messages
description: Get a mailing list's system message templates (welcome, goodbye, opt-in confirmation, error replies…): name, subject, body and last-modified date. Use the name with domain_update_mailing_list_message. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_get_mailing_list_subscriber
description: Get one subscriber's details across your domain's mailing lists: which lists and digests they are subscribed to, custom field values, bounce address, bounce count and history, and the log of list messages sent to them. Requires a domain admin account.

mailingListId.description: Limit the details to one mailing list id (optional)

name: domain_get_password_policy
description: Get your domain's password policy: the server defaults and the domain's overrides (minimum length, required character classes, common-password and username checks, password history, expiration and grace period).

name: domain_get_permissions
description: Get the feature permissions the system administrator has granted your domain (which settings and features the domain may use or override).

name: domain_get_security_settings
description: Get your domain's sender and login security: the domain whitelist (addresses and domains that bypass spam filtering), the forwarding blocklist, login country restrictions, the IP access list, SMTP authentication / SSL / HSTS / TLS / SRS requirements, sending throttles and the external-sender warning settings.

name: domain_get_settings
description: Get the full configuration of your domain (general settings, security options, catch-all, auto-clean, feature permissions). Large response. Password and secret values are redacted.

name: domain_get_signature_mappings
description: Get which signature template applies to which user, alias, domain alias or the whole domain. type: 1 DomainAlias, 2 Domain, 3 Alias, 4 User, 5 SmtpAccount. mapOption: 0 None, 1 UsePrimary, 2 SignatureSpecified (signatureGuid), 3 UseDomainDefault.

name: domain_get_spam_settings
description: Get your domain's spam filtering: whether the domain overrides the server defaults, the low/medium/high spam weight thresholds and the action taken at each level, the server defaults, and the relay/forward spam options.

name: domain_get_user
description: Get the full account details of one user in your domain: settings, permissions, security flags, mailbox size and last login.

username.description: Username (local part, e.g. 'jane') or full email address in your domain

name: domain_get_user_connections
description: Get who is connected in your domain: per-user connection counts, last login (overall and webmail), last authenticating IP and protocol, plus domain-wide counts per protocol (webmail, IMAP, POP, SMTP, ActiveSync, MAPI/EWS, XMPP, WebDAV).

protocol.description: Protocol filter: all (default), webmail, imap, pop, smtp, eas, mapiEws, xmpp or webdav

search.description: Search text matched against usernames (empty for all)

name: domain_get_user_defaults
description: Get the default settings applied to NEW users created in your domain (mailbox size, protocol access, feature permissions, GAL visibility, password lock, auto-clean and more).

name: domain_get_user_group
description: Get one user group in your domain by id: name, enabled state and member usernames.

name: domain_get_user_indexing_status
description: Get the search-index status of one user's mailbox: whether it is indexing, items indexed and still to index, last indexed time and current status.

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address in your domain

name: domain_get_user_login_ips
description: List the IP addresses a user in your domain has signed in from, with location and last-login time, grouped by protocol/category. Useful when investigating a compromised account.

username.description: The user: local part (e.g. 'jane') or full address

name: domain_get_user_mail_settings
description: Get one user's mail settings: can receive mail, forwarding enabled, ActiveSync / MAPI-EWS enabled, mailbox size limit, sending throttles, auto-clean rules, blocked and trusted senders, spam and calendar options.

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address in your domain

name: domain_get_user_statuses
description: Get the account health of users in your domain: enabled, two-factor enabled, expired password, password-policy violations, indexing / migrating state, authentication type and critical errors. Paginated.

search.description: Search text matched against usernames (empty for all)

name: domain_list_aliases
description: List the email aliases in your domain with their target addresses.

search.description: Optional search term to filter aliases

name: domain_list_content_filters
description: List the domain-level content filters, which apply to every user in your domain: id, title, order, enabled state, match type, conditions and actions (enum values are numeric; see domain_add_content_filter for the names).

name: domain_list_domain_aliases
description: List the domain aliases of your domain: other domain names (e.g. example.net) whose mail is delivered to this domain's mailboxes.

name: domain_list_event_hooks
description: List event hooks (automated actions such as notifications that fire on mail events). By default lists the domain-level hooks; pass an owner to list one user's hooks.

owner.description: Owner username to filter by (optional; empty for the domain-level hooks)

startIndex.description: Index of the first hook to return, for paging (default 0)

name: domain_list_mailing_list_posters
description: Search a mailing list's approved posters (addresses allowed to post) or its banned users (addresses that may neither post nor subscribe), with paging. Requires a domain admin account.

listType.description: Which list: 'approved' (default) for approved posters, or 'banned' for banned users

search.description: Only return addresses containing this text (optional)

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0)

take.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100)

name: domain_list_mailing_lists
description: List the mailing lists in your domain: id, list address, description, moderator, status, posting permissions, digest/double opt-in flags and subscriber, digest, poster and banned-user counts. Use the id with the other mailing list tools. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_list_password_issues
description: List users in your domain with password problems: 'noncompliant' (password breaks the current policy; shows which rules), 'expired' (must change before signing in) or 'aged' (approaching or past the maximum age). Paginated.

search.description: Search text matched against usernames (empty for all)

excludeActiveDirectory.description: Leave out Active Directory-authenticated accounts, whose passwords SmarterMail does not manage (default false; ignored for 'expired')

name: domain_list_protocol_mailboxes
description: List the mailboxes in your domain that have ActiveSync or MAPI/EWS (Outlook) access enabled, with display name and last sync time. These are licensed per mailbox.

name: domain_list_shared_resources
description: List the domain-level shared resources: shared calendars, conference rooms, equipment, address books, task and note lists, with their folderId, type, email alias, enabled state, booking window and who has access.

name: domain_list_signatures
description: List the domain's email signature templates (id, guid, name, HTML text, isDefault) and whether a domain signature is in use.

name: domain_list_spam_checks
description: List the DNS blocklists (RBL / URIBL) used for spam checking: name, lookup domain, whether each is enabled for incoming and outgoing SMTP, and how results are weighted.

name: domain_list_subscriber_fields
description: List the custom subscriber fields defined for your domain's mailing lists: id, name and default value. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_list_user_groups
description: List the user groups in your domain (id, name, enabled, member usernames). Pass a username to list only the groups that user belongs to.

username.description: Optional username (local part) or email address: only return this user's groups

name: domain_list_users
description: List the users in your domain with username, email address, full name, disabled state, domain-admin flag, mailbox size and last login.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter matched against username, email address and full name

name: domain_move_content_filter
description: Move a domain-level content filter one place up (evaluated earlier) or down in the processing order.

up.description: true: move up (higher priority); false: move down

name: domain_recalculate_mailbox_sizes
description: Recount the disk usage of one or more mailboxes in your domain, for when the reported size is out of sync with what is actually stored.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

name: domain_reindex_users
description: Rebuild the search index of one or more mailboxes in your domain. Use when search results are missing or wrong. Runs in the background and can take a while for large mailboxes.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

name: domain_remove_mailing_list_posters
description: Remove email addresses from a mailing list's approved posters or from its banned users. Requires a domain admin account.

listType.description: Which list: 'approved' (default) for approved posters, or 'banned' for banned users

name: domain_remove_mailing_list_subscribers
description: Unsubscribe one or more email addresses from a mailing list (regular or digest subscribers). Requires a domain admin account.

digest.description: True to remove them from the digest subscribers instead of the regular subscribers (default false)

name: domain_rename_domain_alias
description: Rename a domain alias (e.g. example.net → example.org). Optionally require the new name's MX records to point here first.

verifyMx.description: Refuse unless the new name's MX records point at this server (default false)

name: domain_rename_user
description: Change a user's username (and so their email address) in your domain. Mail, settings and folders are kept. The old address stops working unless you add an alias for it. You cannot rename yourself with this tool.

username.description: Current username (local part) or email address

name: domain_resync_user_devices
description: Force the connected devices (ActiveSync and other sync clients) of one or more users in your domain to resynchronise. Use to fix devices that stopped syncing.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

name: domain_save_event_hook
description: Create an event hook, or replace an existing one, from a full event-hook JSON object (name, enabled, eventID/eventGroup, conditions[], actions[] with inputs[]; the shape domain_list_event_hooks returns). Get valid events, conditions and actions from domain_get_event_catalog. To edit a hook, read it, change it, and pass it back with its id and isNew:false.

eventHookJson.description: The event hook as a JSON object string

name: domain_save_subscriber_field
description: Create a custom subscriber field for your domain's mailing lists, or rename one / change its default value. Requires a domain admin account.

defaultValue.description: Default value for subscribers who have none (optional)

fieldId.description: Id of an existing field to change (from domain_list_subscriber_fields); omit to create a new field

name: domain_search_accounts
description: Search the users and aliases of your domain together, with status (enabled / disabled / errored), account type, authentication type and ActiveSync / MAPI-EWS flags. Paginated.

search.description: Search text matched against account names (empty for all)

sortField.description: Field to sort by, e.g. 'userName' or 'displayName' (optional)

name: domain_search_mailing_list_subscribers
description: Search the subscribers of a mailing list, with paging. Returns the total match count and the page of subscribers (address, bounce count, last edit). Requires a domain admin account.

search.description: Only return subscribers whose address contains this text (optional)

skip.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0)

take.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 100)

name: domain_send_mailing_list_digest
description: Send a mailing list's pending digest right now, emailing every digest subscriber, instead of waiting for its schedule. Requires a domain admin account.

name: domain_set_catch_all
description: Set the catch-all: the alias that receives mail sent to any address in your domain that does not exist. Pass an empty value to turn the catch-all off.

aliasName.description: Existing alias name (local part) to use as the catch-all, or empty to disable

name: domain_set_event_hook_enabled
description: Turn an existing event hook on or off without changing anything else about it.

enabled.description: true to enable, false to disable

name: domain_set_mailbox_forwarding
description: Set where one user's incoming mail is forwarded. Only what you pass is changed. Pass an empty forwardTo list to stop forwarding. The user's mail settings must also allow forwarding (enableMailForwarding, see domain_update_user_mail_settings).

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address in your domain

forwardTo.description: COMPLETE list of addresses to forward to, replacing the current list (optional; empty list stops forwarding)

deleteOnForward.description: True to delete the message from this mailbox after forwarding; false keeps a copy (optional)

keepRecipients.description: True to keep the original recipients on the forwarded message (optional)

spamForwardOption.description: How spam is treated when forwarding, as SmarterMail names it (see domain_get_mailbox_forwarding for the current value) (optional)

name: domain_set_protocol_access
description: Turn protocols on or off for one or more users in your domain. Only the protocols you pass are changed. ActiveSync and MAPI/EWS are licensed per mailbox and count against the domain's limits.

usernames.description: Usernames (local parts) or email addresses in your domain

name: domain_set_signature_mapping
description: Assign a signature to a user, alias, domain alias or the whole domain, or remove such an assignment. Other mappings are kept.

targetType.description: What the mapping is for: 'user', 'alias', 'domain_alias', 'domain' or 'smtp_account'

target.description: The target's name: a username/local part for user or alias, a domain name for domain_alias or domain

option.description: 'specified' (use signatureGuid), 'domain_default', 'primary', 'none', or 'remove' to delete this mapping

signatureGuid.description: Signature guid from domain_list_signatures (required when option is 'specified')

allowUsersToOverride.description: Let the user override this signature (default true)

name: domain_set_user_group_membership
description: Add one user to, and/or remove them from, user groups in your domain.

username.description: Username (local part) or email address in your domain

addToGroupIds.description: Group ids to add the user to (optional)

removeFromGroupIds.description: Group ids to remove the user from (optional)

name: domain_test_dkim_dns
description: Check whether a DKIM public key is correctly published in DNS. Only performs a DNS lookup; changes nothing. By default tests the active key; set which='pending' to test the rollover key, or pass selector and publicKey to test any key.

which.description: Which of the domain's keys to test: 'active' (default) or 'pending'. Ignored when selector and publicKey are given.

selector.description: DKIM selector to test (optional; must be given together with publicKey)

publicKey.description: Public key to look for in DNS (optional; must be given together with selector)

name: domain_update_alias
description: Update an existing alias in your domain. Only the fields you pass are changed. Passing targets replaces the whole target list.

newName.description: New alias name to rename it (optional)

targets.description: Replacement list of target addresses (optional; replaces the existing list)

internalOnly.description: Only accept mail from inside the domain (optional)

allowSending.description: Let target users send mail as this alias (optional)

hideFromGAL.description: Hide the alias from the Global Address List (optional)

isEnabled.description: Enable (true) or disable (false) the alias; a disabled alias bounces mail (optional)

name: domain_update_content_filter
description: Change a domain-level content filter. Only what you pass changes; conditions and actions, when given, replace the filter's whole list (same format as domain_add_content_filter). Use domain_list_content_filters to find the id.

name: domain_update_dkim_settings
description: Change how your domain signs mail with DKIM (does not change the key). Only the options you pass change; the rest keep their current values.

fieldOption.description: How 'fields' is used: 'include' (sign only these headers) or 'exclude' (sign all but these) (optional)

fields.description: Header field names to include/exclude from signing, e.g. ['From','To','Subject','Date'] (optional; replaces the current list)

maxMessageSign.description: Messages larger than this many bytes are not signed (optional)

name: domain_update_mailing_list
description: Change a mailing list's settings. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else is kept. For settings without their own parameter, pass them in settingsJson using the field names domain_get_mailing_list returns. Requires a domain admin account.

doubleOptIn.description: Require (true) or stop requiring (false) double opt-in (optional)

subjectPrefix.description: Subject prefix text (optional; an empty string turns the prefix off)

showInGal.description: Show (true) or hide (false) the list in the Global Address List (optional)

disabled.description: Disable (true) or re-enable (false) the whole list (optional)

settingsJson.description: Other settings as a JSON object string, e.g. {"listReplyToAddress":"help@example.com","maxMessagesSentPerHour":500} (optional)

name: domain_update_mailing_list_message
description: Change one of a mailing list's system message templates (see domain_get_mailing_list_messages for the names). Some messages have no subject; leave subject out for those. Requires a domain admin account.

name.description: Template name exactly as domain_get_mailing_list_messages returns it

subject.description: New subject (optional; only for messages that have one)

name: domain_update_mailing_list_subscriber
description: Change one subscriber: set custom field values, and/or replace which of your domain's lists and digests they are subscribed to. Only what you pass is changed. Requires a domain admin account.

fieldValuesJson.description: Custom field values as a JSON object string of field name → value, e.g. {"FirstName":"Jane"} (optional; other fields are kept)

subscribedListIds.description: The complete set of mailing list ids they should be subscribed to (optional; replaces the current set)

subscribedDigestIds.description: The complete set of mailing list ids they should receive digests from (optional; replaces the current set)

name: domain_update_password_policy
description: Change your domain's password policy. Only the rules you pass are changed; everything else is kept. Stricter rules affect existing users at their next password change and show up in domain_list_password_issues.

minLength.description: Minimum password length; 0 turns the length rule off (optional)

notUsername.description: Refuse passwords that contain the username (optional)

passwordHistoryCount.description: Number of previous passwords that may not be reused; 0 turns the history rule off (optional)

expirationMonths.description: Password expiration in months; 0 turns expiration off (optional)

expirationGraceDays.description: Grace period in days after expiry before outgoing SMTP is blocked (optional)

name: domain_update_settings
description: Change domain settings. Pass a JSON object of only the settings to change, using the property names domain_get_settings returns (e.g. {"enableMailForwarding":false} or {"externalSenderOverrideSettings":{"enabled":true}}). Nested objects are merged, arrays and plain values replace. Everything you do not mention is kept. Unknown names are refused.

settingsJson.description: JSON object string of the settings to change

name: domain_update_shared_resource
description: Rename a domain shared resource and/or change who can access it. For access, the users you list get the given level; pass removeUsers to take access away. Group access and anyone not mentioned are kept.

folderId.description: folderId from domain_list_shared_resources

users.description: Usernames to grant or change access for (optional)

userAccess.description: Access level for those users: 'availability', 'read', 'manage' or 'owner' (default 'read')

name: domain_update_signature
description: Change a domain signature template's name, text or default flag. Only the fields you pass change.

isDefault.description: Set or clear the default flag (optional)

name: domain_update_spam_settings
description: Change your domain's spam thresholds and actions. Only the values you pass change. Changing weights or actions turns on the domain override of the server defaults unless overrideActive=false is passed. The server administrator may not allow domains to override spam actions. Actions: NoAction, Delete, Bounce, MoveToFolder (argument = folder name), AddHeader (argument = header line), PrefixSubject (argument = prefix text), Forward (argument = address), Read, SetPriority, FollowUp.

overrideActive.description: true: use this domain's own spam settings; false: fall back to the server defaults (optional)

lowWeight.description: Spam weight at which a message counts as low-probability spam (optional)

lowActionArgument.description: Argument for lowAction, e.g. the subject prefix or folder name (optional)

name: domain_update_user
description: Update an existing user in your domain. Only the fields you pass are changed; everything else is kept.

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address of the user to change

password.description: New password (optional); must meet the domain's password requirements

maxMailboxSizeMb.description: New maximum mailbox size in MB (optional; 0 means no limit)

isDomainAdmin.description: Grant (true) or revoke (false) domain administrator rights (optional)

name: domain_update_user_defaults
description: Change the default settings for NEW users in your domain (see domain_get_user_defaults for the field names), e.g. {"hideFromGal":true}. Only the fields you pass are changed. Existing users are not affected.

settingsJson.description: JSON object with the defaults to change, using the field names inside 'settings' from domain_get_user_defaults

name: domain_update_user_group
description: Rename, enable/disable, or replace the member list of a user group in your domain. Only what you pass is changed.

members.description: New COMPLETE member list, replacing the current one: usernames (local parts) or email addresses (optional)

name: domain_update_user_mail_settings
description: Change one user's mail settings (see domain_get_user_mail_settings for the field names), e.g. {"canReceiveMail":false}, {"maxSize":0}, {"throttleSettings":{"messagesPerHour":500}} or {"blockedSenders":["spam@example.com"]}. The fields you pass are merged into the current settings; lists you pass replace the current list.

username.description: Username (local part) or full email address in your domain

settingsJson.description: JSON object with the settings to change, using the field names from domain_get_user_mail_settings

name: domain_update_whitelist
description: Change the domain whitelist: senders (email addresses) and sending domains that bypass spam filtering for every user in your domain. mode 'add' (default) and 'remove' edit the current list; 'replace' sets it to exactly what you pass. Whitelisting a sender lets its spam through, so add only senders you trust.

name: domain_verify_dkim
description: Have SmarterMail validate a DKIM key against DNS and update its status. rollover=false checks the active key; rollover=true checks the pending rollover key and, if DNS matches, makes it the active signing key. Can change which key signs mail. For a lookup that changes nothing, use domain_test_dkim_dns.

rollover.description: false (default): verify the active key. true: verify the pending rollover key and activate it on success.

forceActivation.description: Rollover only: activate the pending key even if DNS validation fails (default false)

name: domain_verify_domain_alias_mx
description: Check that a domain alias's MX records point at this mail server. Only checks DNS; changes nothing. Use after adding a domain alias.

name: download_email_attachment
description: Fetch an email attachment (filenames from get_email_attachments). Text attachments come back as text; binary ones as base64 when includeBase64=true (up to 5 MB). On a local server that shares your filesystem, savePath writes the file there instead.

folderId.description: The folder where the email is located

filename.description: The filename of the attachment to download (from get_email_attachments)

savePath.description: Optional: save to this path on the MCP server's filesystem (a directory gets the attachment's filename). Only works on a local server that shares your filesystem.

includeBase64.description: Return a binary attachment's bytes as base64Content (up to 5 MB). Text attachments are always returned as text.

name: expand_contact_group
description: Expand a contact group to get all member email addresses (including nested groups)

groupId.description: The ID of the contact group to expand

ignoreSubgroups.description: Set to true to ignore nested groups and only return direct members

name: forward_email
description: Forward an email message to other recipients

uid.description: The UID of the email to forward

folderId.description: The folder where the original email is located

to.description: The email addresses to forward to, comma separated

message.description: Optional message to include above the forwarded content

name: get_calendar_event
description: Get a calendar event for a given folder ID and event ID

folderId.description: The folder ID to get the calendar event for

eventId.description: The event ID to get the calendar event for

name: get_calendar_events
description: Get calendar events for a given folder ID and date range

folderId.description: The folder ID to get calendar events for

searchQuery.description: Filter events by searching various fields (optional)

name: get_contact
description: Get full details for a specific contact by ID and source ID

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

contactId.description: The ID of the contact to retrieve

name: get_contact_group
description: Get details of a specific contact group including all members

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

groupId.description: The ID of the contact group to retrieve

name: get_contact_groups
description: Get all contact groups from a specific folder

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

name: get_contacts
description: Get contacts sorted by most recently contacted

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

searchQuery.description: The search query to filter contacts by

maxResults.description: The maximum number of results to return

name: get_content_filters
description:
Get all content filters (inbox rules). Returns filter groups with their conditions and actions.

Condition Field Types: 0=FromAddress, 1=FromDomain, 3=WordsInSubject, 4=WordsInBody, 7=WordsInTo, 10=ToAddress, 16=HasAttachments, 17=AttachmentFilename
Comparison Types: 0=Equals, 1=DoesntEqual, 2=Contains, 3=DoesntContain
Action Types: 1=Delete, 4=MoveToFolder, 5=AddHeader, 6=PrefixSubject, 7=Forward, 8=MarkAsRead
Match Types: 0=And (all conditions), 1=Or (any condition)

name: get_email_attachments
description: List an email's attachments: filename, contentType (from the file name), approximate size (SmarterMail rounds to KB) and the content IDs of images embedded inline in the body. Read a text attachment with read_email_part; download_email_attachment fetches any of them.

folderId.description: The folder where the email is located

name: get_email_message
description: Get a specific email message by UID and folder

uid.description: The UID of the email to retrieve

folderId.description: The folder path where the email is located

includeBody.description: Whether to include the message body in the response

includeHeader.description: Whether to include the message headers in the response

name: get_emails
description: Get email metadata like subject, from, date, id, read, flagged, etc. from a specific folder with optional search and pagination

folderId.description: The folderID to get emails from (accepts <username>/<folderPath> as well, ex: jdoe/Inbox or jdoe/<folderid>)

skip.description: The number of emails to skip (for pagination).

take.description: The maximum number of emails to return.

query.description:
Optional search query to filter emails. Supports flags in query:
                - is:(un)read/is:(un)flagged/is:(un)replied/is:attachment - filter by status
                - Can combine multiple filters with spaces and optional search query (ex: "is:attachment is:unread searchterm")

name: get_global_address_book
description: Get contacts from the global address book

name: get_note
description: Get a single note's full information by ID

noteId.description: The ID of the note to retrieve

folderId.description: The ID of the note source

name: get_notes
description: Get notes from a specific note source

folderId.description: The ID of the note source

name: get_task_details
description: Get details for a specific task

folderId.description: The ID of the task source

taskId.description: The ID of the task to retrieve

name: get_tasks
description: Get all tasks from a specific task folder

folderId.description: The ID of the task source

name: get_user_data
description: Get user data

name: list_folder_info_by_type
description: List folder information of folders by type

type.description: The type of folders to list: 1=email, 2=calendars/tasks, 3=contacts, 4=notes

name: move_emails
description: Move emails to a different folder

uid.description: The UIDs of the emails to move, comma separated

srcFolderId.description: The folder the emails are in

destFolderId.description: The folder to move the emails to

name: new_or_update_calendar_event
description: Create a new calendar event or update an existing one

folderId.description: The ID of the calendar folder to add/update the event to

startTime.description: The start time of the event (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)

endTime.description: The end time of the event (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss)

eventId.description: The ID of the event to update (if it exists)

attendees.description: Comma separated list of email addresses of attendees

name: new_or_update_task
description: Create a new task or update an existing one

folderId.description: The ID of the task source (if null, primary source will be used)

taskId.description: The ID of the task to update (if it exists)

percentComplete.description: The percentage of the task that is complete (0-100)

start.description: The start date of the task (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)

due.description: The due date of the task (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)

reminder.description: The reminder date of the task (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm)

name: read_email_part
description: Inventory, window, or grep any part of an email. Omit part for an inventory of html/plain/text/headers/attachments with sizes. Set part (html, plain, text derived from HTML, headers, or attachment:<filename>) to read a window with offset/limit. Set pattern to grep (literal by default; isRegex=true for regex). Window responses include totalChars, nextOffset, and hasMore so you can page through large bodies.

folderId.description: The folder ID or path where the email is located

part.description: Part to read: html, plain, text (HTML converted to plaintext), headers, or attachment:<filename>. Omit or leave empty for inventory.

pattern.description: Search pattern. When set, switches to grep mode instead of a windowed read.

isRegex.description: Treat pattern as a regular expression. Default false (literal substring).

offset.description: Window start offset in characters. Default 0.

limit.description: Window size in characters. Default 8000. 0 means through the end, still capped at 200000.

contextChars.description: Characters of context around each grep match. Default 300.

maxMatches.description: Maximum grep matches to return. Default 20.

name: remove_emails
description: Remove emails from the system

uid.description: The UIDs of the emails to remove, comma separated

folderId.description: The folder the emails are in

name: remove_folder
description: Remove folders for the user

folderIds.description: The id's of the folders to remove, in the format 'owner/numeric_id'. Child folders are also removed. (comma separated)

name: remove_items
description: Remove items from the system (notes, tasks, contacts, events)

itemId.description: The IDs of the items to remove, comma separated (id/guid only)

itemType.description: The type of the item to remove - note, task, contact, event

calendarId.description: The ID of the calendar to remove the event from (required for events)

name: reply_to_email
description: Reply to an email message

uid.description: The UID of the email to reply to

folderId.description: The folder where the original email is located

replyAll.description: Set to true to reply to all recipients, false to reply only to sender

name: respond_to_meeting
description: Respond to a meeting invitation (accept, decline, or tentative)

folderId.description: The ID of the calendar folder containing the meeting

eventId.description: The event ID of the meeting

comment.description: Optional comment to include with your response

name: run_content_filters
description: Run content filters against a folder to process existing emails

folder.description: Folder path to run filters on (e.g., 'Inbox')

filterIds.description: Optional: comma-separated filter IDs to run. If empty, runs all enabled filters.

name: search_items
description: Search for items in the system (mail, notes, tasks, contacts, events)

section.description: The area to search in: Everywhere, Email, Notes, Contacts, Calendar, Tasks

or.description: Use OR logic for multiple search terms (default: false for AND logic)

maxEmailsToReturn.description: Maximum number of email results to return (default: 250)

name: send_draft
description: Send a previously saved draft email

draftUid.description: The UID of the draft to send

folderId.description: The folder where the draft is located (usually 'Drafts')

name: send_email
description: Send a simple email

to.description: The email addresses to send the email to, separated by commas

name: send_email_with_attachments
description: Send an email with previously uploaded attachments. Use upload_attachment first, then pass its attachmentGuid here. Inline images uploaded with inline=true are shown where the body has with their htmlReference.

to.description: The email addresses to send the email to, separated by commas

body.description: The body of the email (HTML supported; reference inline images as )

name: set_email_properties
description: Mark emails as read/unread, flagged/unflagged, or add tags

uid.description: The UIDs of the emails to mark, comma separated

folderId.description: The folder the emails are in

read.description: Whether to mark the emails as read or unread

flagged.description: Whether to mark the emails as flagged or unflagged

tags.description: The tags to add to the emails, comma separated

name: set_trusted_senders
description: Set trusted senders (whitelist) to bypass spam filtering. Accepts email addresses and/or domains.

name: unblock_senders
description: Unblock previously blocked senders. Accepts email addresses or domains.

senders.description: Comma-separated email addresses or domains to unblock

name: update_contact
description: Update an existing contact in the specified folder

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

contactId.description: The ID of the contact to update

additionalInfo.description: Additional notes about the contact (can be HTML)

isHtml.description: Whether additional info is HTML formatted

name: update_contact_group
description: Update an existing contact group (add/remove members or rename)

folderId.description: The ID of the contact folder

groupId.description: The ID of the contact group to update

addEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to add to the group

removeEmails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses to remove from the group

newGroupName.description: New name for the group (leave empty to keep current name)

newDescription.description: New description for the group (leave empty to keep current)

name: update_content_filter
description:
Update an existing content filter. Only provided fields will be updated.

See create_content_filter for conditions and actions JSON format.

filterId.description: Filter ID to update (use get_content_filters to find IDs)

name: update_folder
description: Update or create a folder for the user

type.description: The type of the folder to update (email, calendar, notes, tasks, contacts)

name.description: The new name for the folder

parentFolderId.description: The parent folder ID (owner/numeric_id) to nest the folder in (only for email create/update)

folderId.description: The ID (owner/numeric_id) of the folder to update. If omitted, a new folder is created

color.description: The hex color for the folder (only for calendars and tasks, e.g., #FF0000)

name: update_note
description: Update a note in the specified folder

noteId.description: The ID of the note to update

folderId.description: The ID of the note source

content.description: The html or plain text content of the note

color.description: The hex color to associate with the note

name: upload_attachment
description: Upload a file to attach to an email, then send it with send_email_with_attachments using the returned attachmentGuid. Give the file as exactly one of: base64Content (any file, base64-encoded), text (a text file's contents, e.g. .txt/.csv/.ics/.html) or filePath (only on a local server that shares your filesystem). For an image shown inside the HTML body, set inline=true and use the returned htmlReference as the src: . SmarterMail assigns the content ID, so always use the returned value. Several files go in one email by passing the first call's attachmentGuid to the next calls.

fileName.description: The attachment's file name, e.g. report.pdf or banner.png. Required with base64Content or text; the extension sets the content type unless contentType is given.

base64Content.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded (a data: URL is accepted too).

text.description: The file's contents as text (sent as UTF-8). Use for text files instead of base64Content.

filePath.description: Path to a file on the MCP server's own filesystem. Only works when the server shares your filesystem (a local stdio server); otherwise use base64Content or text.

contentType.description: Optional MIME type, e.g. image/png. Defaults from the file name's extension.

inline.description: true to embed the file (an image) in the HTML body via cid: instead of attaching it. The result's htmlReference is the src to use.

attachmentGuid.description: Optional: the attachmentGuid from an earlier upload_attachment call, to add this file to the same email.
